commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a fragile 21% and scanner gates flashing WEAK, institutional discipline mandates capital preservation and progressive exposure. Stan Weinstein's stage analysis and William O'Neil's market-direction rules emphasize that even pristine setups face heightened failure rates during broad index corrections and persistent institutional distribution. Under current headwinds, false breakouts predominate and defensive rotation creates deceptive strength. Exposure must be strictly rationed to genuine Stage 2 leaders displaying verified CANSLIM growth—surpassing 25% earnings expansion on double-digit sales—while quickly cutting laggards. Until breadth broadens and benchmark accumulation resumes, aggressive buying should be restrained, stops kept tight, and cash protected.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

21STCENMGM.technical: Cleared a 20-session high into fresh annual highs above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. MACD confirms trend template alignment, though erratic microcap volumes create heightened susceptibility to false breakouts.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Erratic financial performance driven by non-operating capital market swings rather than steady core business operations. While Q1 FY27 posted ₹10 Cr revenue and ₹9 Cr profit, historical operating losses and negative cash flows lack CANSLIM quality.
21STCENMGM.risk: Break below 49.05 stop violates the breakout pivot and rising 21-EMA, requiring an immediate risk cut.

63MOONS.technical: Traded above key moving averages but flashed a classic Livermore danger signal by poking above the 967.57 pivot before closing back below it, revealing overhead distribution and trapped buyers.
63MOONS.fundamental: Despite reported top-line expansion to ₹136 Cr in Q1 FY27, core profitability deteriorated sharply into a ₹39.7 Cr net loss. Subpar ROE of 1.5% and persistent operating losses disqualify institutional CANSLIM backing.
63MOONS.risk: Setup fails on a break below 852.07 stop; overhead distribution signals significant supply overhang.

ACUTAAS.technical: Constructive consolidation within 1.5% of the 4036.23 pivot on expanding volume (1.4x 20-day average). Strong relative strength, rising 50-SMA/200-SMA alignment, and positive MACD reflect textbook Minervini Stage 2 progression.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: Stellar CANSLIM profile with Q2 FY27 net profit surging 71% YoY on 43% revenue growth. EBITDA margins expanded over 900 bps to 40.3%, complemented by negligible debt (D/E 0.02) and an ROE exceeding 20%.
ACUTAAS.risk: Thesis fails on a close below 3663.39 stop, forfeiting EMA21 dynamic support and base structure.

AEROFLEX.technical: Carved a clean double-bottom base with decisive accumulation volume (2.9x 20-day average) pressing against neckline resistance. Price holds securely above upward-sloping EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, signaling Stage 2 health.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: High-grade fundamentals powered by surging liquid cooling solutions demand. Q2 FY27 PAT leaped 158% YoY on 87% revenue expansion. OPM holds firm at 24%, reinforced by a virtually debt-free balance sheet and 19% ROCE.
AEROFLEX.risk: Violated if price breaches 527.24 stop, undercutting the double-bottom swing low and 50-SMA.

AGARWALEYE.technical: Executed a clean 20-day breakout to new highs backed by massive accumulation volume (7.13x 20-day average). RSI at 69 reflects strong momentum while moving averages confirm a mature Stage 2 uptrend.
AGARWALEYE.fundamental: Robust specialty healthcare model showing steady compounding. Q1 FY27 EPS surged 51% YoY on 23% top-line growth. Operating margins remain steady at 28%, and amalgamation synergies enhance balance sheet efficiency with low leverage.
AGARWALEYE.risk: Breakout invalidates below 535.00 stop, signalling institutional rejection and a false breakout trap.

ANUHPHR.technical: Formed a textbook double bottom above rising 50-SMA and 200-SMA, accompanied by an aggressive 8.67x volume surge. Momentum indicators are firm, but overhead supply lingers near the psychological 100 level.
ANUHPHR.fundamental: Net profit grew 47% YoY in Q2 FY27 due to margin expansion and product mix, but revenue growth remained stagnant at ~4% YoY, failing CANSLIM's top-line hurdle. Negligible debt and 15% ROCE maintain balance sheet health.
ANUHPHR.risk: Thesis terminates on breakdown below 90.29 stop, breaching double-bottom base support.
